headlines.title: VST, CEG Stocks Drop As Election Outcome Hits Merchant Power Generators
headlines.summary: Incoming Texas governor Gina Hinojosa has advocated an immediate pause on new data-center construction, an end to related tax incentives, and stronger local controls over water and electricity use.

headlines.title: Constellation Energy Sinks 8%, Vistra Down 14% as Democrats’ Midterm Sweep Hits AI Power Stocks
headlines.summary: Key TakeawaysConstellation Energy fell 8% this morning after Democrats won Congress, in a selloff that also hit Vistra, GE Vernova and CoreWeave. Its signed deals with Alphabet’s Google and Amazon still stand, so the risk is in future contracts.

headlines.title: GE Vernova Sinks 10%, Vistra Down 12% as Democrats Win Congress: “Incrementally More Negative Sentiment”
headlines.summary: Key TakeawaysGE Vernova fell 10% today, with Vistra and Constellation Energy, after Democrats won both chambers of Congress. Only about 20% of GE Vernova’s contracted gas turbine capacity serves data centers.

headlines.title: Vistra Sinks 10%, Constellation Down 6% as Democrats’ “Blue Tsunami” Hits AI Power Stocks
headlines.summary: Key TakeawaysVistra stock fell 10% today after Democrats won Congress and Texas, pulling Constellation Energy, GE Vernova and Vertiv down too. Texas Governor-elect Gina Hinojosa campaigned on a moratorium on new data centers.

headlines.title: Constellation Energy Corporation (CEG) Is a Trending Stock: Facts to Know Before Betting on It
headlines.summary: Recently, Zacks.com users have been paying close attention to Constellation Energy Corporation (CEG). This makes it worthwhile to examine what the stock has in store.

description: Constellation Energy Corporation produces and sells energy products and services in the United States. The company operates through five segments: Mid-Atlantic, Midwest, New York, ERCOT, and Other Power Regions. It offers electricity, natural gas, energy-related products, and sustainable solutions. The company has approximately 31,676 megawatts of generating capacity consisting of nuclear, wind, solar, natural gas, and hydroelectric assets. It serves distribution utilities, municipalities, cooperatives, and commercial, industrial, public sector, and residential customers. The company was incorporated in 2021 and is headquartered in Baltimore, Maryland.
